one_line: Chaulukya queen who commissioned Rani-ki-Vav, a monumental stepwell at Patan in 11th‑century Gujarat.

appearance.age_look: mid-30s, composed and dignified, medium build with a graceful posture suggesting both royal authority and practical involvement in architectural planning
appearance.face: oval face with warm medium-brown Gujarati complexion, straight nose, soft but observant dark-brown eyes with slightly thick brows, a small bindi at the forehead center, and a calm default expression that mixes gentle empathy with focused determination
appearance.hair: long black hair parted in the middle, smoothed back and gathered into a low braided bun at the nape, wrapped with a narrow gold hairband and secured by a single small lotus-shaped gold hairpin; no veil, keeping the head uncovered for clarity of silhouette
appearance.costume: era-accurate 11th‑century western Indian royal attire: a full-length, ankle-covering cotton-silk sari in muted deep maroon with a subtle golden border of repeating small floral motifs, draped in an early nivi-style over a short-sleeved, high-neck choli in dull gold; the pallu comes over her left shoulder and across her torso in clean folds, leaving the sari pleats centered in front; beneath, a plain off-white petticoat ensures the silhouette stays modest; she wears a fitted maroon waist-belt (kambarband) with small hanging gold plaques, a medium-width gold necklace with simple bead-like forms, a single longer chain ending in a small pendant, modest gold bangles on both wrists, small round gold ear-studs, and a plain gold ring on her right hand; her feet are in simple brown leather sandals with a toe loop, practical for walking along the stone edges of the stepwell; textiles are matte, with occasional soft sheen in the borders rather than flashy shine
appearance.signature: a rolled palm-leaf architectural plan tied with a thin red cord in her left hand, its edges slightly curved and one end subtly marked with faint ink grid lines and stepwell outlines, symbolizing her patronage and involvement in Rani-ki-Vav’s design

ref_desc: Udayamati of Patan is a mid-30s Gujarati queen with an oval medium-brown face, calm focused expression, long black hair in a low braided bun with a gold hairband, wearing a deep maroon cotton-silk sari with dull-gold borders over a gold choli, modest gold jewellery and brown sandals, holding a rolled palm-leaf architectural plan, in a palette of maroon, dull gold, off-white, warm brown and soft stone-grey.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character model of Udayamati of Patan, shown as a dignified Chaulukya-period queen in mid-11th-century Gujarat: a woman in her mid-30s with an oval medium-brown face, straight nose, thoughtful dark-brown eyes and a small bindi, her default expression calm and focused as if overseeing construction. Her long black hair is parted in the middle, smoothed back and gathered into a low braided bun at the nape, encircled by a narrow gold hairband and fixed with a single small lotus-shaped gold hairpin. She wears a full-length, ankle-covering cotton-silk sari in deep maroon with a subtle repeating floral golden border, draped in an early nivi-style over a short-sleeved, high-neck dull-gold choli; the pallu crosses her torso from the right waist over her left shoulder in neat, weighty folds, and all garments stay modest, with no bare torso. A plain off-white petticoat gives a solid silhouette beneath. Around her waist is a fitted maroon cloth belt with small hanging gold plaques. Her jewellery is restrained: a medium-width gold necklace of bead-like forms, a single longer chain with a small pendant, modest gold bangles on both wrists, small round gold ear-studs, and a simple gold ring on her right hand. On her feet are simple brown leather sandals with a toe loop, practical for walking along stone steps. In her left hand she holds a rolled palm-leaf architectural plan tied with a thin red cord, with faint ink grid lines and stepwell outlines visible at one end; her right hand is relaxed at her side, suggesting confident authority. Use a palette dominated by deep maroon, dull gold, off-white, warm brown and soft stone-grey, and present her in a neutral stance, front-facing, with clear views of face, hairstyle, full costume and the rolled palm-leaf plan, as a consistent reference for an educational historical anime about Rani-ki-Vav and Chaulukya Gujarat hydraulic architecture.
